description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for the Articles in the application, including a query class, a validator, and a handler that fetches article data by slug.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Request object containing the article slug, used to fetch article details.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the fetching of article data based on the slug, throws not found error if article does not exist.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the query to retrieve the article envelope or throws an exception if not found.
